common.app.description: A Traditional Chinese Medicine self-assessment: describe how you feel and see which pattern fits best, and why. For education only; it does not replace a health professional.
common.app.name: TCM Self-Check
common.backup.card.intro: Your results are saved only in this browser, which can discard them. A backup is a file you keep: you can restore it here later or on another device.
common.backup.card.never: You have not made a backup yet.
common.backup.card.reminder: Remind me to make a backup
common.backup.card.reminder.hint: A short reminder on the History page and the start page when you have results that are not in a backup.

common.install.status.accepted: Installing. The app will appear in your app list.
common.install.status.dismissed: Not installed. You can install it later from here or from your browser’s menu.

common.settings.erase.body: This deletes: preferences, the assessment in progress, all saved results and the files this browser cached for this app. It cannot be undone.
common.settings.erase.sync: A file you chose for the backup is not deleted: the app only forgets it.
common.settings.erase.title: Erase everything on this device
common.settings.links.sources: See the sources and their review status
common.settings.privacy.backup.remove: Delete the file yourself; this app keeps no copy
common.settings.privacy.backup.where: Wherever you save it: a folder, a USB stick, a cloud drive. It contains health information.
common.settings.privacy.birth.until: You close the page, unless you chose to remember it
common.settings.privacy.birth.where: Memory only for this visit; stored in IndexedDB only if you tick “Remember on this device”
common.settings.privacy.caption: What this app stores on this device
common.settings.privacy.draft: The assessment in progress (profile, warning-sign answers, symptoms)
common.settings.privacy.draft.remove: “Discard” on the start page, or erase everything
common.settings.privacy.draft.until: You finish, discard or erase it
common.settings.privacy.hosting: The server that delivers this page may log connections as web servers usually do (for example the IP address); your answers are never sent, so they cannot appear there.
common.settings.privacy.intro: Everything you enter stays in this browser on this device. There are no accounts, no server that receives your answers, no analytics and no cookies.
common.settings.privacy.lock: The lock, if you turn it on (a record that lets your passphrase open the history, and a small marker; the passphrase itself is never stored)
common.settings.privacy.lock.remove: “Turn the lock off…” in the “Lock the history” card, or erase everything
common.settings.privacy.lock.until: You turn the lock off, or erase everything
common.settings.privacy.never: Never collected: name, email, phone, accounts, device identifiers, precise location, photos.
common.settings.privacy.offline.remove: “Remove offline copy” in the card above, or erase everything
common.settings.privacy.offline.until: You remove it, or the browser clears it
common.settings.privacy.offline.where: The browser (Cache Storage); only the files of this app, nothing you entered
common.settings.privacy.prefs: Preferences (language, appearance, text size, the statement you read)
common.settings.privacy.prefs.remove: “Erase everything on this device” on this page
common.settings.privacy.shared: Data stored by the browser may be included in device backups and may be visible to other people who use the same browser profile. On a shared device, erase everything after use.
common.settings.privacy.sync: The file you chose for the backup, where the browser can (its handle, and a fingerprint of what was last written — never the passphrase)
common.settings.privacy.sync.remove: “Stop keeping it up to date” in the “Keep a backup file up to date” card, or erase everything
common.settings.privacy.sync.until: You stop keeping it up to date, or erase everything (the file is not deleted)
common.settings.privacy.sync.where: The browser (IndexedDB); the file itself is in the folder you chose, encrypted
common.settings.privacy.title: Privacy: what is stored
common.settings.rememberBirth.hint: Start each assessment with “Remember my birth data on this device” ticked, so a birth date you enter is kept with your saved results. Off by default; you can still untick it on the birth card.
common.settings.seasons.intro: A result can take the season into account. The app counts the seasons by the calendar and by this choice; it does not know the climate where you are.
common.settings.seasons.north.hint: Spring begins in early February, as in the classical texts.
common.settings.seasons.note: Only the season changes. The birth chart, the solar terms and the year's five periods and six qi are the same everywhere, and results already saved keep the choice they were made with.
common.settings.seasons.off.hint: For the tropics, where four seasons are not the climate. A result then leaves the season out.
common.settings.seasons.south.hint: The season you live in: spring begins in early August and summer in early November.
common.settings.seasons.suggested: Not chosen yet: this device's time zone suggests the {basis}.

common.sources.intro: The content of this app comes from the classical books and open data listed below. All of it is currently a draft: it has not yet been reviewed by a qualified practitioner.
common.sources.licences.body: The quotations come from classical books that are in the public domain and were checked against the open text collection TCM-Library (MIT licence). The herb data are derived from TCM-Library and, as structured facts, from the Pharmacopoeia of the People's Republic of China. The names, coordinates and time zones of the cities in the birth-place list are from GeoNames (geonames.org), licensed under CC BY 4.0; the selection, and some Chinese names, are ours. The question lists, the interface text and the English wording were written for this app, which is released under the Apache License 2.0. The full attributions and licence texts are in the notice file.

common.sync.failure.full: There is no room to write it. The file is as it was.

common.sync.failure.passphrase: That is not the passphrase of this file. Nothing was changed.

common.sync.intro: Choose a file in a folder that your own cloud service keeps in step between your devices — iCloud Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, Google Drive. After each change the app writes an encrypted backup to it. The service sees only an encrypted file; nothing goes to any server of this app.
common.sync.limits: The app writes the file only while it is open, and asks for the file’s passphrase each time you open it: it does not keep the passphrase.
common.sync.merge.action: Merge and keep it up to date
common.sync.merge.intro: “{name}” holds changes from another device. Look at what is new, then merge.
common.sync.merge.title: Merge the file
common.sync.passphrase.label: Passphrase of the file
common.sync.setup.intro: The app will keep an encrypted backup in a file you choose. Nobody can read it without the passphrase, and nobody can recover the passphrase for you.
common.sync.setup.other: To use the file of another of your devices, choose that file and type the passphrase you gave it there: its results are merged into this device before anything is written.
